message.en: !important breaks the maintainability of the cascade

hint.zh-CN: 优先降低选择器优先级或调整规则顺序，而不是叠加 !important。
hint.en: Prefer lowering specificity or reordering rules instead of stacking !important.

message.zh-CN: 字号使用 px 不会随用户字体设置缩放
message.en: A px font size does not scale with the user's font settings

hint.zh-CN: 改用 rem（如 1rem / 1.5rem）以支持缩放与无障碍。
hint.en: Use rem such as 1rem or 1.5rem to support zoom and accessibility.

message.zh-CN: 空规则集可能是重构残留
message.en: An empty rule set may be a refactoring leftover

hint.zh-CN: 删除空规则，或补上真正需要的声明。
hint.en: Remove the empty rule or add the declarations that are actually needed.

message.zh-CN: 本行可能有未闭合的花括号
message.en: This line may contain an unclosed brace

hint.zh-CN: 检查 { 与 } 是否成对，嵌套规则是否正确闭合。
hint.en: Check that { and } are paired and nested rules close correctly.

message.zh-CN: 移除 outline 会让键盘焦点不可见
message.en: Removing outline hides the keyboard focus indicator

hint.zh-CN: 改为 :focus-visible 提供高对比度焦点环，而不是直接去掉。
hint.en: Provide a high-contrast focus ring with :focus-visible instead of removing it.

items.detail: 宽度包含内边距与边框
